# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues,
discussions, or mailing lists.  Instead, use GitHub's private vulnerability
reporting form for IvorySQL:

<https://github.com/IvorySQL/IvorySQL/security/advisories/new>

Include the affected IvorySQL version or commit, operating system, build
options, a minimal reproducer, and the security impact when that information
is available.  The maintainers will coordinate follow-up through the private
advisory.

For vulnerabilities that also affect unmodified PostgreSQL code, consult the
PostgreSQL security reporting guidance as well:

<https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/>
